Definition: to lave (the whole or a part of a thing)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to wash, wash off, wash away, bathe; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to wash, wash off, wash away; 1a2) to wash, bathe (oneself); 1b) (Pual) to be washed; 1c) (Hithpael) to wash oneself
